g.text: Donors and acceptors introduce shallow states and shift the equilibrium Fermi level

font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Square lattice is a conceptual bonding locator, not silicon crystallography. A donor supplies an electron; an acceptor creates a hole after accepting an electron.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Donor state lies below E_C, acceptor above E_V; dashed gold indicates Fermi-level shift qualitatively. Freeze-out, compensation and degenerate doping can alter

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: carrier behavior; dopant symbols do not prescribe chemical species.
